typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[Pr_GenerateXML_PSD]',
	schemaName: '[Delinquency]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Col_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Col_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> FlatFileDestination
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
